crossRefs.note: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and…
Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and…
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’ ”

translations.web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
translations.bsb: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
translations.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
translations.asv: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.
